tamacon.tamacraft.welcome.title: Welcome!
tamacon.tamacraft.welcome:
The Tamacon knows everything about the ten rare pets of this world and how to make them happy.

Use the arrows, your mouse wheel or the arrow keys to turn the pages, and click a chapter on the contents page to jump there.

Tip: craft a Tamacraft Heart first (red dye and an amethyst shard). You need it to tame a pet.
tamacon.tamacraft.finding.title: Finding pets
tamacon.tamacraft.finding:
Pets live in structures, but not in every one: each structure rolls once whether a pet lives there.

Desert pyramid: Desert Dragon. Jungle temple: Jungle Dragon. Ocean monument: Tide Dragon. Igloo: Frost Penguin. Nether fortress: Ember Pup. Ancient city: Sculk Wisp. End city: Void Kitten. Trail ruins and mineshafts: Pebble Golem. Swamp hut: Hex Toad. Trial chambers and woodland mansions: Mimic.

In modpacks, pets also live in look-alike structures from other mods, like the pyramids, witch huts, mineshafts and mansions of Repurposed Structures.

Wild pets stay near their home and never despawn. Look inside and around the building. The cute ones run away when hit, the Ember Pup, Sculk Wisp and Mimic bite back.

Hold a Tamacraft Heart and wild pets come closer. Right-click one with the heart to tame it.
tamacon.tamacraft.controls.title: Controls
tamacon.tamacraft.controls:
Right-click with an empty hand: pet it.

Sneak + right-click with an empty hand: open the pet screen with its needs, mood, backpack and the Sit / Follow / Wander buttons.

Sneak + right-click with a chest: put a backpack on.

Sneak + right-click with shears: take the backpack off. Careful: everything inside spills out!

Right-click with the Tama Pager: Sit / Stay or Follow.

Right-click with food or its favorite treat: feed it. With a golden apple: it goes into its backpack. With the Pet Brush: groom it. Leads and name tags work like on any pet.
tamacon.tamacraft.care.title: Taking care
tamacon.tamacraft.care:
Every pet has four needs from 0 to 100: Hunger, Fun, Energy and Hygiene. Together they make its mood: Ecstatic, Happy, Okay, Sad or Miserable.

Hunger: food, its favorite treat or a Food Bowl.
Fun: petting, toys, other pets, the Bouncy Mushroom, the Running Wheel, the Scratching Post, the Toy Box and plushies.
Energy: sleeping in a Pet Bed, Basket or Dragon Nest, or sitting.
Hygiene: the Pet Brush or a filled Pet Bath.

Happy pets use their talent, sad ones do not, and miserable pets refuse to fight. Bond (the hearts on the screen) grows with every bit of care and makes talents recharge faster.

Needs only change while the pet is loaded, so a pet left at home waits for you.
tamacon.tamacraft.pager.title: Tama Pager
tamacon.tamacraft.pager:
You get a free Tama Pager when you tame your first pet, and you can craft more.

Right-click your pet with it to tell it to stay or to follow you. Use it in the air to open the screen of your nearest pet (up to 64 blocks away).

While it is in your inventory it beeps when a pet is hungry, bored, sleepy, dirty or hurt.
tamacon.tamacraft.backpack.title: Backpack
tamacon.tamacraft.backpack:
Sneak + right-click your pet with a chest and it wears a backpack with 27 slots. Open it with sneak + right-click (empty hand) and put anything in.

Golden apples in the backpack are special: when your health gets low, your pet runs to you and feeds you one. Right-click your pet with a golden apple to pack it straight into the backpack.

Food in the backpack is the pet's own lunch box: when it gets hurt in a fight, it eats from it.

Sneak + right-click with shears takes the backpack off and everything spills out.
tamacon.tamacraft.combat.title: Fighting
tamacon.tamacraft.combat:
Your pet fights with you like a wolf: it attacks whatever attacks you and whatever you attack, each pet in its own style.

Below a third of its health it stops fighting, runs to you and eats food from its backpack to heal.

A tamed pet never dies. It faints and curls up into a Tama Egg that keeps its name, needs, bond and backpack. Use the egg on a block to wake it up again.
tamacon.tamacraft.flying.title: Flying dragons
tamacon.tamacraft.flying:
The Desert, Jungle and Tide Dragon have wings and use them. When you are far away or up on a ledge, a dragon simply flies after you, and now and then it takes off just for the joy of it.

Dragons never take fall damage. Tell one to stay with the Tama Pager and it stays on the ground.
tamacon.tamacraft.food.title: Food
tamacon.tamacraft.food:
Pet Kibble: every pet likes it. It also fills a Food Bowl.

Favorite treats feed more, heal more and give bond: Dragon Fruit (dragons), Fish Crackers (Tide Dragon, Frost Penguin, Void Kitten), Ember Jerky (Ember Pup), Rock Candy (Pebble Golem), Glow Gummy (Sculk Wisp, Hex Toad) and the Golden Biscuit (Mimic).

Pets also eat their usual food: meat, fish, fruit or vegetables depending on the pet. Everything is craftable.
tamacon.tamacraft.toys.title: Toys
tamacon.tamacraft.toys:
Laser Pointer: hold right-click and your pets chase the red dot and pounce on it.

Squeaky Ball: throw it and your pet fetches it back to you.

Feather Wand: wave it near your pets and they jump and swipe at it.

Pet Brush: grooming fills Hygiene. Pets also play with each other when they meet.
tamacon.tamacraft.furniture.title: Furniture
tamacon.tamacraft.furniture:
Pets use furniture by themselves when they need it.

Pet Bed, Pet Basket, Dragon Nest: they sleep in them at night or when tired.
Food Bowl: right-click it with food, hungry pets eat from it.
Pet Bath: fill it with a water bucket, dirty pets splash around in it.
Bouncy Mushroom: pets (and players) bounce on it.
Running Wheel: a pet runs inside it, and it gives a redstone signal while it spins.
Scratching Post: fun for claws.
Pet House: a shelter from rain and thunder.
tamacon.tamacraft.gadgets.title: Pet gadgets
tamacon.tamacraft.gadgets:
Treat Dispenser: fill it with treats or pet food and give it a redstone pulse (a button, a clock, a daylight sensor). It shoots one treat in an arc to the hungriest pet nearby, and the pet jumps and catches it.

Pet Incubator: put a Tama Egg in. It glows warm for thirty seconds, the egg wobbles, and your pet hatches fully healed and rested. Click it with an empty hand to take the egg out early.

Toy Box: a chest for toys. Bored pets open it by themselves and play with what is inside (real pet toys are the most fun).

Pet Flap: put it in a one-block hole in a wall. Your pets walk right through, everyone else bumps into it.
tamacon.tamacraft.decor.title: Decoration
tamacon.tamacraft.decor:
Plushies: there is a plush of every pet. Click one to squeeze it. Lonely pets come and cuddle plushies, and a pet that sleeps next to a plush of its own kind rests half again as fast.

Pet Portrait: hang it on a wall and click it with an empty hand: it paints your nearest pet with its name. Click again to paint the next pet.

Egg Lamp: a glowing night light, click it to switch it on and off.

Dye: click the Pet Bed, Pet Basket, Egg Lamp or the portrait backdrop with any dye to change its colour. Broken furniture keeps its colour.
tamacon.tamacraft.reactions.title: Little moments
tamacon.tamacraft.reactions: Pets react to the world around them: they dance to a playing jukebox, hop to note blocks, look up at bells, warm up at a campfire at night, sniff flowers, beg for cake and for the food you eat, hide from thunder and explosions, shake off water, cheer when you level up, curl up next to your bed when you sleep and play chase with other pets. The Frost Penguin belly-slides on snow and ice.
tamacon.tamacraft.desert_dragon.title: Desert Dragon
tamacon.tamacraft.desert_dragon:
Lives in desert pyramids (40%).

Talent - Ember Roast: Hand it raw food or raw ore and it roasts or smelts it with a little puff of flame.

Favorite treat: Dragon Fruit.

Fights with a puff of fire that sets enemies alight.

It is a dragon, so it flies after you when that is faster, and sometimes just for fun. Sand and sun make it happy.
tamacon.tamacraft.jungle_dragon.title: Jungle Dragon
tamacon.tamacraft.jungle_dragon:
Lives in jungle temples (40%).

Talent - Green Thumb: Makes the crops and saplings around it grow.

Favorite treat: Dragon Fruit.

Fights with a poison bite.

It flies after you when that is faster, and sometimes just for fun. Leaf wings, a hibiscus flower and a very green thumb.
tamacon.tamacraft.tide_dragon.title: Tide Dragon
tamacon.tamacraft.tide_dragon:
Lives in ocean monuments (50%).

Talent - Tide Blessing: While you swim near it you get Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace.

Favorite treat: Fish Crackers.

Fights with a bubble blast that knocks enemies back.

It swims as well as it flies and never needs air under water. Bring it along when you dive!
tamacon.tamacraft.frost_penguin.title: Frost Penguin
tamacon.tamacraft.frost_penguin:
Lives in igloos (45%).

Talent - Frost Steps: While it follows you, water freezes under your feet. Belly-slides on snow and ice.

Favorite treat: Fish Crackers.

Fights with a volley of snowballs that slows enemies.

On snow and ice it belly-slides. It never gets cold, but it loves a warm campfire anyway.
tamacon.tamacraft.ember_pup.title: Ember Pup
tamacon.tamacraft.ember_pup:
Lives in nether fortresses (30%).

Talent - Warm Heart: When you catch fire it gives you Fire Resistance. Swims through lava.

Favorite treat: Ember Jerky.

Fights with a burning bite.

Fire and lava cannot hurt it, and it swims through lava like other pets swim through water.
tamacon.tamacraft.sculk_wisp.title: Sculk Wisp
tamacon.tamacraft.sculk_wisp:
Lives in ancient cities (50%).

Talent - Echo Sense: Sends out a sonar ping that makes hostile mobs nearby glow through walls.

Favorite treat: Glow Gummy.

Fights with a sonic chirp.

It floats instead of walking and is so quiet that sculk sensors never notice it.
tamacon.tamacraft.void_kitten.title: Void Kitten
tamacon.tamacraft.void_kitten:
Lives in end cities (30%).

Talent - Item Magnet: While you are near, it pulls dropped items around it into its backpack, or teleports them to you.

Favorite treat: Fish Crackers.

Fights with a blink strike: it teleports next to the enemy.

If it gets lost it simply teleports back to you.
tamacon.tamacraft.pebble_golem.title: Pebble Golem
tamacon.tamacraft.pebble_golem:
Lives in trail ruins (35%) and mineshafts (8%).

Talent - Ore Sniffer: Sniffs out the best ore nearby (ores from other mods too), points a sparkle trail at it and makes it glow through the walls.

Favorite treat: Rock Candy.

Fights with a heavy ground slam.

Slow but very tough. The ore it sniffs out glows through the walls for twenty seconds.
tamacon.tamacraft.hex_toad.title: Hex Toad
tamacon.tamacraft.hex_toad:
Lives in swamp huts (45%).

Talent - Brew Buddy: When it is happy it brews you a random helpful potion effect now and then.

Favorite treat: Glow Gummy.

Fights with a hex tongue that weakens.

It hops everywhere and loves rain and swamps.
tamacon.tamacraft.mimic.title: Mimic
tamacon.tamacraft.mimic:
Lives in trial chambers (30%) and woodland mansions (60%).

Talent - Treasure Belly: Has 27 slots of belly storage (54 with a backpack) and coughs up little treasures.

Favorite treat: Golden Biscuit.

Fights with a big chomp.

A living chest! Its belly already holds 27 items without a backpack, 54 with one.
